chunks.title: Glycemic assessment (demo guideline excerpt)
chunks.text: For many non-pregnant adults with type 2 diabetes, assess glycemic control with A1C and discuss targets individualized to comorbidities and hypoglycemia risk. When A1C is above goal, evaluate adherence, lifestyle, and medication factors before intensifying therapy.

chunks.title: Lipid monitoring (demo guideline excerpt)
chunks.text: Review fasting lipid panel results in context of ASCVD risk. Repeat testing intervals depend on prior values, therapy changes, and secondary causes; emphasize shared decision-making for statin therapy when indicated.

chunks.title: Hypertension follow-up (demo guideline excerpt)
chunks.text: Confirm home or office blood pressure readings when diagnosing or adjusting therapy. Screen for secondary causes when resistant hypertension is suspected and reinforce sodium reduction and physical activity counseling.
